CostGuardrails.description: The Nov 9-23 window guardrails as config, not prose: the runtime reads these and refuses past them (refusal = the fail-closed floor, never an error page).

alarm.description: CloudWatch alarm shape: daily estimated charges OR daily invocation count past threshold notifies the operator SNS topic.

concurrency_cap.description: Reserved concurrency (Lambda) / max instances cap (App Runner) / AgentCore session cap — one number, host-mapped.

evidence_root.description: Where stamped evidence sets resolve from, inside the deployment.

model_id.description: The model the span invokes. A config value, never code: swapping models (or providers, per SPEC section 4) touches this file alone.

SecretRef.description: A secret the span needs, BY NAME ONLY. Values live in AWS Secrets Manager and are injected as environment at deploy time; no value ever appears in this artifact, in git, or in a receipt.

StorageConfig.description: The strands-dynamodb-storage persistence binding (SPEC section 6): one pre-created table + the TTL attribute + the optional S3 offload bucket for values over the 400 KB item limit.

description: The deployment side of the span: the config the runtime reads (validated against DeploymentConfig), the secrets it consumes BY NAME (SecretRef — values never appear), and the cost guardrails for the Nov 9-23 window as machine-readable config. The IAM policy document itself lives in ../deployment/iam-policy.json (a policy, not a schema — validated structurally by ../validate_schemas.py: no wildcard actions, no wildcard resources).
title: StudySprint production deployment — config, secret names, guardrails
